exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: profile.esm_spacing: Exclude ESM observations spaced less than 60 minutes apart

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite nonnegative difference in minutes between corrected questionnaire-start timestamps for a row and its lagged row after the source's one-time ordering by raw questionnaire-start timestamp.
outputBoundary: Exclude the later row when that precomputed gap is strictly less than 60 minutes and retain it at equality or above.
limitations: This predicate does not sort rows, correct timestamps, partition participants, or choose the lagged row; those source operations occur upstream.
The released code computes every lag before removing rows, so the lag is the immediately previous prefilter row rather than the previous retained row.
The first ordered row has no lag and is retained by the source's R which/index removal; that first-row branch is outside this scalar predicate.
The paper-level wording says within 60 minutes of another questionnaire, while the released code operationalizes only the preceding-row gap after ordering.
No timestamp precision, rounding, clock, timezone-correction, or tolerance behavior is inferred beyond the released strict comparison.
Missing, negative, or nonfinite gap input fails closed rather than being interpreted as a retained first row.
